title: CP-1/CP-3 FlexNodeDescriptor v1alpha1 (release descriptor)
description: Config blob (mediaType application/vnd.flex.node.descriptor.v1+json) of a flexNode release manifest, written by `flex release` (flexmodel/release/pipeline.py) and the probe release tools. It is covered by the release signature (the manifest digest). The engine reads only: safetyClass, interfaceHash, health, restartPolicy, runOptions, plc.download; the other fields are owned by the release tool and typed loosely here.
$comment: Health spec, restart policy and run options live here (signed), not in the desired state: the cloud cannot widen them. Additive-only within v1alpha1. Unknown keys allowed (release-tool owned) except unregistered x- keys; registered: x-flex-mcu.

interfaceHash.description: FLEX01 interface hash (FLEXSYS01 for a system record). Reported as status.interfaceHash; preflight compares it with the payload (mcu-module header, plc-verify spec). null for a base-image (mcu-firmware) release.

profiles.description: Driver profiles this release has payload layers for; 'system' is a record-only composite release (no driver deploys it). The engine selects the layer by its dev.flex.profile annotation (CP-3).

safetyClass.description: Model-derived (flex safety). Must equal the deployment's x-flex-safetyClass (default none), else the engine rejects the manifest.

download.description: plc-verify refuses a release that asks for a PLC download (decision 2026-10-16).

parameters.description: Module parameter declarations from the model (not yet checked against deployment parameters: EV-25).

composite.description: Members of a composite release (App Lab app, PLC bridge, system); checked by flexCloud against the model.

HealthProbe.description: Health gate spec. The engine runs drv.health(dep, probe) every periodSeconds; the gate passes after successThreshold consecutive successes once minSeconds have passed (forward installs only), fails at timeoutSeconds or at once when the driver reports a terminal failure (fail-fast). Engine defaults when absent: successThreshold 1, periodSeconds 0.25, timeoutSeconds 10, minSeconds 0.

type.description: Informational: what the profile's driver checks (drivers do not dispatch on it). os-rauc: booted slot = target slot, not marked bad, device-side healthChecks; plus an http probe on 127.0.0.1 when port is set. arduino-ota: the node's flexCloud version key = dev.flex.firmwareVersion, status key RUNNING (driver healthyStatus) and a live heartbeat key; status ERROR fails fast.

port.description: http: container port probed on the container IP (default 8080). The native driver allocates the port itself and passes it as FLEX_HEALTH_PORT, so native releases say "${FLEX_HEALTH_PORT}".

minSeconds.description: Soak: commit only after the workload was observed healthy this long (MCU confirm window).

RestartPolicy.description: Local supervision. container: docker/podman --restart (always -> unless-stopped, never -> no, else on-failure:maxRetries); Ankaios ALWAYS/NEVER/ON_FAILURE; native: Restart= semantics with RestartSec and a start limit (maxRetries within 60 s). Empty = driver default (on-failure, 5).

RunOptions.description: Extra docker/podman run options (container profile only, not Ankaios). Every value must be on the device's allow-list (engine config drivers.container.allowedRunOptions), else apply fails.

FlxmFacts.description: FLXM v1 header facts of one module build (flxm.Header.to_dict()).

McuFacts.description: Informational MCU facts (the engine does not read them; preflight reads the FLXM header itself). Three shapes exist today: per CPU profile (flex release, multi-arch), flat (probe P3 release tool, single build), base-image facts (mcu-firmware).
